records.camping_summary: Ordinance 2016-2 allows camping trailers on a parcel if registered with the zoning administrator, subject to a removal period and a winter ban.
records.limits_summary: Trailer must leave the parcel at least 60 continuous days per calendar year; no use Jan 1 to end of Feb without a winter camping permit; max 4 trailers; not a permanent dwelling.
records.structures_summary: One storage shed up to 8 x 10 ft (no permanent foundation) and one platform up to 6 x 8 ft allowed with a camping trailer; no decks or additions. In-ground septic, well or electric with a trailer needs a lawful year-round dwelling or a zoning permit.
records.sanitation_summary: Sewage and water must meet health department and state rules; trash must be removed off site.

records.sanitation_summary: Outhouses only in AG-F, on 2.5+ acres with 200 ft width, 50 ft setbacks and a health department permit (§3.25).

records.camping_summary: County zoning allows an RV as a temporary recreational dwelling with a temporary permit in agricultural and L-R districts; no private tent-camping rule found.

Residential accessory structures of 200 sq ft or less need no zoning permit but must meet setbacks; other structures, even movable ones, typically need a zoning permit.
